project.name: Sample operator project
project.summary: A script and a workflow_dispatch workflow, cataloged so the wizard can ask for their flags before running them.

briefing.title: What you can run
briefing.body: Deploy the sample locally with sample-script.sh, or see how a GitHub Actions input is recorded for gh workflow run. The workflow file in this folder is a fixture, not an installed workflow.

tasks.title: Deploy the sample
tasks.summary: Print a deploy line for staging or production. Pass a dry run to print the plan and write nothing.
tasks.details: Staging is the default. The script accepts --env staging or --env production, and --dry-run. A dry run still belongs to a task that can write, so the wizard asks before it runs.
prerequisites: You are in the sample project directory

inputs.name: --env
inputs.help: staging is the default. production is the other accepted value.

inputs.name: --dry-run
inputs.help: Print the plan and write nothing.

tasks.title: Dispatch the sample deploy workflow
tasks.summary: Start the sample workflow with its environment input.
tasks.details: gh workflow run takes each workflow_dispatch input as -f name=value. This fixture's file is sample-workflow.yml. A real project points the command at the workflow file that is installed in .github/workflows.
prerequisites: The workflow is installed on the GitHub repo you are targeting

inputs.name: -f
inputs.help: Sets the workflow_dispatch input named environment.
